title: Adafruit Learn: Adafruit VL53L4CD Time of Flight Distance Sensor (guide PDF: Overview, Pinouts, Downloads)
supports: 2.8 V sensor on a breakout with regulator and level shifting, 3-5 V power or logic
VIN: power the board at the microcontroller logic level
GND common ground
default I2C address 0x29
SCL and SDA each have a 10K pull-up
two STEMMA QT connectors
GPIO: interrupt output, 2.8 V logic level
XSHUT: shutdown, active low, level shifted for 3 V or 5 V logic
LED jumper on the back cuts power to the on LED
Downloads: datasheet, EagleCAD PCB files, 3D models on GitHub
